import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = {
        '0.7268': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_0.csv',
        '0.016157143': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_1.csv',
        '0.17657143': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_2.csv',
        '6.9': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_3.csv',
        '0.0075805085': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_4.csv',
        '0.0179': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_5.csv',
        '242.364': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_6.csv',
        '301.0': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_7.csv',
        '20.3333': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_8.csv',
        '0.1646': 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/test_9.csv'
    }

    # Load each source CSV into a DataFrame and rename the value column to the target column name
    dfs = []
    for col, path in source_files.items():
        df = pd.read_csv(path)
        # Ensure the date column is named consistently
        if '2012-12-05' not in df.columns:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected date column '2012-12-05' not found in {path}")
        # Rename the value column to the target column name (which is the same as col)
        # The source schema is ['2012-12-05', col], so col is the second column
        value_col = [c for c in df.columns if c != '2012-12-05'][0]
        df = df.rename(columns={value_col: col})
        dfs.append(df)

    # Merge all dataframes on '2012-12-05' using inner join to keep only dates present in all sources
    from functools import reduce
    target_df = reduce(lambda left, right: pd.merge(left, right, on='2012-12-05', how='inner'), dfs)

    # Convert data types according to target schema:
    # '2012-12-05': string (date as string)
    # '301.0': integer
    # all other columns: float
    target_df['2012-12-05'] = target_df['2012-12-05'].astype(str)
    # Convert '301.0' to integer
    target_df['301.0'] = target_df['301.0'].astype(int)
    # Convert all other columns except '2012-12-05' and '301.0' to float
    for col in target_df.columns:
        if col not in ['2012-12-05', '301.0']:
            target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype(float)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema order exactly
    target_columns_order = ['2012-12-05', '301.0', '0.0075805085', '0.0179', '6.9', '0.17657143',
                            '20.3333', '0.016157143', '242.364', '0.1646', '0.7268']
    target_df = target_df[target_columns_order]

    # Write the result to the specified path
    output_path = 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_11/target_multisource_cot.csv'
    target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
